# Anping ChenCai Metal

> > Leading manufacturer of expanded metal mesh, perforated metal sheets, and industrial filter solutions in stainless steel, aluminum, and galvanized materials.

Anping ChenCai Metal Manufacture Co., Ltd. specializes in architectural metal products including curtain wall systems, ceiling panels, and precision filtration components. Products are available in SS304, 316L stainless steel, aluminum, galvanized steel, and carbon steel with custom perforation patterns and finishes including PVDF coating.
